versions.content: Enable/disable Events by configuration The configuration pa- rameter DemEventAvailableInVariant shall be used as master to consider an 62 of 535 Document ID 19: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticEventManager Specification of Diagnostic Event Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 Event as enabled or disabled. If the configuration parameter DemEventAvail- ableInVariant is set to FALSE, the Dem shall treat the Event as if it is not config- ured as DemEventParameter . If DemEventAvailableInVariant is not set or set to TRUE, the Dem shall consider the Event as enabled depending on other sources.

Enable/disable Events by configuration The configuration pa- rameter DemEventAvailableInVariant shall be used as master to consider an Event as enabled or disabled. If the configuration parameter DemEventAvail- ableInVariant is set to FALSE, the Dem shall treat the Event as if it is not config- ured as DemEventParameter . If DemEventAvailableInVariant is not set or set to TRUE, the Dem shall consider the Event as enabled depending on other sources.
